questions.question: What is digital output in Arduino?
questions.solution_html:
• (Definition- (2.5 marks) , Explanation- (2.5 marks)
  • Arduino board is a small microcontroller board, which is a small circuit(the board) that
  • contains a whole computer on a small chip(the microcontroller).Arduino Uno consists of 14
  • digital input/output pins (of which 6 can be used as PWM outputs), 6 analog inputs, a 16
  • MHz crystal oscillator, a USB connection, a power jack, an ICSP header and a reset button.
  • It consists of 14 digital inputs/output pins, each of which provide or take up 40mA current.
  • Some of them have special functions like pins 0 and 1, which act as Rx and Tx respectively,
  • for serial communication, pins 2 and 3-which are external interrupts, pins 3,5,6,9,11 which
  • provides pwm output and pin 13 where LED is connected.

questions.question: Define Internet of Things (Io T).
questions.solution_html:
• (Definition- (2 marks) , Characteristics- (3 marks)
  • The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to a network of interconnected physical objects such as
  • devices, machines, vehicles, or people embedded with sensors, software, and unique
  • identifiers that enable them to collect, exchange, and process data over a network without
  • requiring direct human-to-human or human-to-computer interaction.
  • Characteristics of IoT
  • INTERCONNECTIVITY- With regards to IoT, anything can be interconnected to the
  • global information and communication infrastructure.
  • HETEROGENEITY- The devices in IoT are heterogeneous based on different hardware
  • platforms, applications and networks. They can interact with other devices through different
  • networks.
  • SAFETY- IoT must be designed with safety in mind. This includes safety of our personal
  • data and the safety of our physical devices.
  • Naming & Addressing- The names and addresses of devices connected to Internet of Things
  • should be unique.

questions.question: What is Raspbian OS?
questions.solution_html:
• (Definition- (2 marks) , Features- (3 marks)
  • Raspbian, officially rebranded as Raspberry Pi OS, is the official, free operating system
  • developed by Raspberry Pi Holdings specifically for their single-board computers. Built on
  • top of Debian Linux, it is optimized to run smoothly on the low-power hardware of the
  • Raspberry Pi.
  • Optimized for the Pi: It is specifically compiled to take full advantage of the Raspberry Pi's
  • processor and hardware features, offering the best out-of-the-box performance.
  • Pre-packed Software: It comes with a massive suite of pre-installed educational and
  • programming tools (like Python, Scratch, and Thonny) as well as everyday software like the
  • Chromium/Firefox browsers and LibreOffice.
  • User-Friendly Desktop: It features a lightweight, user-friendly desktop environment (labwc
  • / Wayland-based) that makes it feel familiar to Windows or macOS users.

questions.question: Briefly explain the evolution of Raspberry Pi models
questions.solution_html:
• (Definition- (2.5 marks) , Explanation- (1.25 marks) each)
  • RASPBERRY PI MODELS
  • There have been many generations of the Raspberry Pi line: from Pi 1 to 4, and even a Pi
  • 400.
  • There has generally been a Model A and a Model B of most generations.
  • Model A has been a less expensive variant, and tends to have reduced RAM and fewer ports
  • (such as USB and Ethernet). The Pi Zero is a spinoff of the original (Pi 1) generation, made
  • even smaller and cheaper.
  • Raspberry pi 4 model b
  • • This model has just been released.
  • • This model has broken the mold of connector positioning on the Raspberry Pi that has
  • remained the same since the release of the Raspberry Pi B+ in 2014.
  • The Pi Zero W is roughly half the size of the Pi 3 B or Pi 4 B, and it has a single micro-USB
  • socket for communication, and a second one for power.
  • • The Pi Zero W also saves space by using a mini-HDMI socket and micro-USB on-
  • the-go socket.
  • • If you want to connect a keyboard, monitor and mouse to a Pi Zero, you will need
  • adapters for both the USB and the HDMI port before you can connect standard
  • peripherals.

questions.question: Discuss the importance of Linux commands in Raspberry Pi operations.
questions.solution_html:
• (Definition- (2 marks) , Importance- (2 marks) each)
  • Linux commands play a vital role in operating and managing a Raspberry Pi because the
  • Raspberry Pi OS is based on Linux. They allow users to efficiently control the system,
  • manage files, configure hardware and troubleshoot issues.
  • • File and Directory Management
  • • Commands such as ls, cd, mkdir, and rm help users create, access, organize, and
  • delete files and folders.
  • • System Administration
  • • Commands like sudo, passwd, and shutdown are used for user management, system
  • control, and security.
  • • Software Installation and Updates
  • • Commands such as apt update and apt install enable users to install, update, and
  • manage software packages.
  • • Hardware and Network Configuration
  • • Linux commands help configure GPIO pins, network settings, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and
  • connected devices.
  • • Troubleshooting and Monitoring
  • • Commands like top, df, free, and ping are used to monitor system performance and
  • diagnose problems.
